caption_link.limitation: The source provides matching numeric IDs only. It does not provide an original post URL, date, media link, or an explicit asset-to-caption key.

inspection.evidence_scope: Source-bound start, material-intermediate, and near-complete frames were extracted from the original local GIF and visually inspected; metadata came from that same source file.

motion_sampling.method: Three source-bound frame samples extracted from the original local GIF for review; no derivative was added to the corpus.
motion_sampling.limitation: The samples show a very restrained connector treatment, not a frame-by-frame reconstruction of path timing or platform playback.

visual_anatomy.title: A plain title names a seven-level strategy taxonomy, with the subject isolated in one oversized lavender rough-display tag.
visual_anatomy.layout: Seven full-width horizontal coloured strata are numbered down the left. The centre contains increasing numbers of example chips; a narrow right rail groups the strata under three stated audience-growth outcomes.
visual_anatomy.reading_order: Headline → left-side ordered layer names → scan examples across the same layer → use the right rail to interpret the broad grouping.
visual_anatomy.typography: Large light sans title, rough-display emphasis, bold numbered layer labels, and compact one- or two-line chip labels.
visual_anatomy.colour: Pastel lavender, pink, aqua, blue, tan, green, and purple establish seven strata; the right rail uses pale related panels rather than a new visual family.
visual_anatomy.surface: White background, very light tinted row fields, thin dark outlines, small rounded cards with subtle shadows, and dotted connector routes.
visual_anatomy.modules: Seven hierarchy rows, left rank markers, nested central content-card clusters, dotted relationship paths, and three consequence panels.
visual_anatomy.density: High but ordered: horizontal band membership resolves the large number of example chips before the reader has to parse each label.

motion.observed_state_change: The full taxonomy remains readable in all three samples. Small dots travel or shift along the dotted connector routes between row-level cards; no important category, label, or outcome is introduced only through motion.
motion.motion_job: Add a restrained cue that the examples are related across layers, while preserving the taxonomy as a static reference.
motion.limitation: The samples show a very restrained connector treatment, not a frame-by-frame reconstruction of path timing or platform playback.

transferable_mechanism.reader_job: Locate a named example in the right level of an ordered taxonomy, then understand the consequence of operating at that level.
transferable_mechanism.argument_shape: Seven-level hierarchy with examples and a small outcome grouping.
transferable_mechanism.mechanism: Use stable horizontal strata as the primary organising device, place examples directly inside their stratum, and use connection cues only to reveal real relationships between levels.
transferable_mechanism.use_condition: Use only for a genuine ordered hierarchy where the vertical position carries a defensible meaning; do not imply growth, speed, or maturity without support.

anti_copy_boundary: Do not reuse the seven content-strategy layers, example taxonomy, audience-growth statements, right-side outcome grouping, row colours, dotted connector choreography, title treatment, or rough-display tag.

claim_boundary.note: The source makes explicit assertions about content layers and audience-growth speed. The workbook caption is only numerically associated, and those assertions are not independently verified.
